segments.en: Today I practise computer English in a real conversation. I need to explain a small task clearly to another person. I say "terminal" when I talk about my computer project. I say "command line" when I talk about my computer project. I say "shell" when I talk about my computer project. I tell my teammate: Today I use terminal, command line, and shell. At the end, I say: I can use terminal clearly today.

segments.zh: 今天口语练习围绕“计算机英语”，场景是“命令行和终端”。先听英文，再尝试不看中文复述。terminal：终端，用文字命令操作电脑的窗口。示例：I learned how to use "terminal" in a computer task.command line：命令行，输入和执行文本命令的环境。示例：I learned how to use "command line" in a computer task.shell：命令解释器，读取并执行用户输入的命令。示例：I learned how to use "shell" in a computer task.最后用自己的经历替换示例中的内容，再说一遍。

I tell my teammate: Today I use confirm the time, Does Tuesday work?, and I'm not available then.. At the end, I say: I can use confirm the time clearly today.

segments.zh: 今天口语练习围绕“GitHub 项目英语”，场景是“自动检查状态”。先听英文，再尝试不看中文复述。status check：状态检查，自动判断提交是否满足要求。示例：Our team uses "status check" to keep the project clear.required check：必需检查，合并前必须通过的检查。示例：Our team uses "required check" to keep the project clear.pending check：等待中的检查，尚未产生结果。示例：Our team uses "pending check" to keep the project clear.最后用自己的经历替换示例中的内容，再说一遍。

segments.zh: 今天口语练习围绕“GitHub 项目英语”，场景是“自动检查状态”。先听英文，再尝试不看中文复述。passing check：通过的检查，自动验证成功。示例：Our team uses "passing check" to keep the project clear.failed check：失败的检查，自动验证没有通过。示例：Our team uses "failed check" to keep the project clear.check details：检查详情，显示自动任务的日志和结果。示例：Our team uses "check details" to keep the project clear.最后用自己的经历替换示例中的内容，再说一遍。
